title: NGM Agar Preparation Protocol
author: Adrien Assie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zy7f7zn

steps.title: Cool Agar Medium
steps.instruction: Cool the medium to 55 °C, utilizing a water bath to accelerate the process if necessary.

steps.title: Add Supplements
steps.instruction: Add the following reagents while stirring on a heat plate, ensuring the mixture is not overheated:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 5 mg/mL Cholesterol (dissolved in ethanol).
Add 25 mL of 1 Molarity (M) Potassium Phosphate Buffer, pH 6.0 (sterile).

steps.title: Pour Plates
steps.instruction: Pour the medium into petri dishes using sterile technique according to the dish size:

substeps.instruction: For 60 mm dishes: approximately 7 mL per plate.
For 100 mm dishes: approximately 20 mL per plate.
